subject: Fix #19 - Remove aux type loading code not related to JSON
reason: The change only removes aux-type stubs (scdtype00, ft_index0, graphdata, GEARS_DT0, GEAR_REQ0) that let a JSON-only server skip foreign module aux blobs (RediSearch/RedisGraph/RedisGears) when loading an RDB produced elsewhere. These stubs have aux_load but no aux_save, and valkey-json's own DocumentType uses rdb_save/rdb_load (not module aux), so valkey-json never writes any of these aux fields. The only behavioral difference is loading a pre-existing RDB that already contains those foreign aux sections; the fuzzer loads only valkey-json plus pinned Valkey and can generate RDBs solely through
